basic_info.description: Welcome to 1700 Cayuga Ave, a charming single-family home nestled in the heart of San Francisco. This beautifully maintained residence offers a perfect blend of classic charm and modern convenience. With 1,651 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this home features two spacious bedrooms and two tastefully renovated bathrooms. A large bonus room on the ground floor is currently utilized as a 3rd bedroom.    Step inside to discover a light-filled interior with six inviting rooms, including a stunning open kitchen that is sure to delight any culinary enthusiast. The kitchen boasts premium counters and is equipped with state-of-the-art stainless steel appliances, including a gas oven, gas stove, dishwasher, and energy-efficient appliances. The range hood and refrigerator complete this chef's dream setup.    Although the home is near the freeway, the neighborhood is down hill from the road and given it's proximity, the backyard is remarkably usable; perfect for relaxation or entertaining guests. The attached garage provides convenient parking and a large amount additional storage space. Plenty of space for a garage workshop as well as laundry space, ensuring your laundry needs are met with ease.
